Game Overview

Run from Baba Yaga puts players into a adventure experience centered on navigate a magical, ever-shifting forest filled with treasure and peril. Control six unique characters as you outsmart the dreaded Baba Yaga. Strategically traverse the hexagonal path, maximizing both your escape route and your loot. How long can you evade her clutches while amassing golden riches?
